import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from setuptools.build_meta import build_wheel
out=Path('/app/artifacts/quality-v4-wheel-backend')
assert not out.exists()
out.mkdir()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='uiux-v4-wheel-',dir='/data/tmp') as temporary:
    copied=Path(temporary)
    shutil.copytree('/app/src',copied/'src',ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('__pycache__','*.egg-info'))
    for name in ('pyproject.toml','LICENSE'):
        shutil.copyfile(Path('/app')/name,copied/name)
    os.chdir(copied)
    wheel=out/build_wheel(str(out))
    with zipfile.ZipFile(wheel) as archive:
        entries=[name for name in archive.namelist() if name.startswith('retail_pipeline/') and not name.endswith('/')]
        resources={}
        for name in entries:
            actual=archive.read(name)
            expected=(Path('/app/src')/name).read_bytes()
            assert actual==expected,name
            resources[name]=hashlib.sha256(actual).hexdigest()
    probe="import json,sys; sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1]); import retail_pipeline.report_view as view; from retail_pipeline.report_model import ReportPayload; page=view.build_report_html(ReportPayload()); assert 'Perfil e comparação' in page and 'Sem publicação' in page and 'OFL' in page; assert '.whl/' in view.__file__; print(json.dumps({'module':view.__file__,'html_bytes':len(page.encode())}))"
    render=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-c',probe,str(wheel)],cwd=copied,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
    receipt={'wheel':wheel.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':wheel.stat().st_size,'package_files':len(entries),'byte_equality':True,'resources':resources,'isolated_render':json.loads(render.stdout),'builder':'setuptools.build_meta.build_wheel (84.0.0)','build_isolation':False,'network':'none'}
    (out/'wheel-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({key:value for key,value in receipt.items() if key!='resources'}))
